correctness.rationale: The proof handles every parameter t>1/4 in four adjacent regimes, including the small inverted simplex, the opposite pair of 8-facet chambers, the central octahedron and the original simplex. The facet plane support heights, face area multipliers, and A_i h_i=3 Vol(T) lead exactly to both mixed-volume coefficients. Symmetry of mixed volume gives the difference-body ratio 2+6rho. Explicit factorizations show strict monotonicity; one-sided cubic expansions give C2 but not C3. A standalone exact-rational polytope checker independently reconstructed 12 vertices/facet configurations and verified 24 precise volume/mixed-volume identities. Numerical tests are only auxiliary.

The tetrahedral equal-cap path is a natural affine-invariant deformation with two simplex endpoints and one centrally symmetric octahedron. The new formulas give the entire mixed-volume and difference-body ratio, the unique sharp minimum, two strict phases and a C2/non-C3 change at the face-lattice transition. These are precise structural measurements, not just routine re-expression of a known bound.
